metadata.description: Agent Skills for Amazon sellers running the TrackIQ MCP.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-daily-snacks-email
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Daily Snacks Email — a three-minute editorial daily email for an Amazon seller account. One lead story with a takeaway, quick bites, a scoreboard, charts, product-line rankings, rank/BSR and a to-do list.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-weekly-executive-report
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Weekly Executive Report — a client-ready week-over-week Amazon recap. Scorecard, pacing against the brand's own trailing four-week average, marginal return by product line, DSP breakout, keyword economics and inventory days-of-cover.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-category-priority-keywords
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Category Priority Keywords — groups the catalogue into product categories and picks the 25 search terms per category worth tracking organic rank on, each with weekly volume, estimated monthly revenue, impression share and a rank-tracking gap check.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-amc-media-mix
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon AMC Media Mix — a twelve-slide Amazon Marketing Cloud path-to-purchase and media mix deck. Which ad combinations recruit new customers, what DSP is worth alone versus in a path, cost per new customer by channel, and one budget reallocation with the arithmetic shown.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-search-visibility-audit
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Search Visibility Audit — where your ASINs appear in Amazon search. Every revenue-bearing query placed as owned, doubled, bought or absent; the paid/organic overlap; share of voice; and the revenue behind the queries you are absent from. No third-party API required.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-rank-readiness
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Rank Readiness — decides which search terms deserve advertising or seeding spend on an ASIN by testing whether a bought organic rank would hold once the money stops. FUND / SEED / TEST / NO-GO per keyword plus a designed HTML report.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-share-of-shelf
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Share of Shelf — how much of page one a brand owns for its revenue-bearing keywords, and which competitors hold the rest. Weighted by revenue, not volume. Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection (1 credit per keyword per run); there is no first-party substitute.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-listing-monitor
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Listing Monitor — watches listings daily and alerts only when something actually moved: title and bullet rewrites, lost images, missing A+, category moves, buy box changes, price and rating thresholds, suppressions. Silence is the normal output. Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection and snapshot storage.
